F01.change: Recover local Brent deadlines; preserve global TimeoutError

F02.change: Memoize shared construction dependencies and maximum literal scale

F03.change: Keep rank-chart assembly and typed coordinates at requested precision

F04.change: Use exact float tuple seed identity

F06.change: Evaluate closed endpoints and adjacent representable interior points

F07.change: Bracket every scalar residual and select distinct local norm minima

F08.change: Stable hypot norm and direct sign comparison
F08.final_reason: 極端な値だけhypotへ切り替え、通常域の残差ノルムと二乗スコアは従来の計算順・丸めを維持。初期版の一律hypot化でNOMADの探索列が変化したため、有限値の安全性と通常域の再現性を分離。

F09.change: Second-order one-sided finite differences on domain boundaries

F10.change: Equilibrate refinement rank tests; explicit verifier error threshold unchanged

F11.change: Merge evaluation failure counts using the evaluation population

F12.change: Bounded scalar branch scan before primary NOMAD can terminate with one root
F12.reason: Fixed tuning families expose systematic partial answer sets even when development-corpus partial sets are few. Compare general scalar branch discovery without changing final verification.
F12.final_reason: 全残差を使う最大2秒のscalar探索を主探索へ接続。候補は通常の精密化と最終検証へ渡す。冗長式でscalar反復数が64へ減らないよう修正。

F13.change: Expand inferred fallback sides by factor eight while preserving mathematical sides
F13.final_reason: 推定範囲の拡張はscreenで1件改善したが、同じ取りこぼしをscalar探索で解消。最終版は範囲を変更しない。

F14.final_reason: 候補の品質重み付けとraw/scaled切替の実験は正答数を増やさず、1078.14秒へ悪化。安定なノルム計算のみF08として残す。

F15.change: Bounded TRF primary local solver experiment
F15.final_reason: bounded TRFは同じ正答数で1077.08→1148.67秒。元の多変数探索を維持。

F16.reason: A failed evaluator supplies no valid directional residual; replacing it without a domain-specific valid extension would add an unsupported objective. One-sided differences and bounded TRF are tested separately.
F16.final_reason: A failed evaluator supplies no valid directional residual; replacing it without a domain-specific valid extension would add an unsupported objective. One-sided differences and bounded TRF are tested separately.

F17.final_reason: 品質重み付き選択は同じ正答数で1068.92→1078.14秒。元の選択順を維持。

F18.change: Round-robin candidate quanta with high-precision resume
F18.final_reason: 候補間の段階的再開は正答数を増やさず、1063.69→1067.51秒。複雑さに見合う効果なし。

F19.change: Record source identity, revisions and phase history across resumed refinement
F19.final_reason: 再開スケジューラと一緒に撤回。既存revision・phase history・artifact読取互換性は維持。

F20.change: Successive answer stability stops extra closure after 250 digits; unchanged final uncertainty verifier
F20.limitation: Work allocation heuristic, not a certified uncertainty bound
F20.final_reason: Full 969-run evaluation exposed false early stability: 250-digit candidates pass initial verification but fail later 500-digit domain boundary/uncertainty verification. Removing the stop restores five distance-zero failures and a deadline case in the predeclared regression investigation.

F21.change: Keep best completed local probe on local cutoff
F21.final_reason: 局所中断時の追加保持は正答数を増やさず、1078.14→1077.08秒の微差のみ。

F22.change: Bounded near-observation integer tuple heap enumeration
F22.final_reason: 整数部分列挙は正答数を増やさず。最終scalar修正の効果から切り離して撤回。

F23.change: Compare candidate round-robin schedule under existing finalization reserve
F23.final_reason: 最終化予約の3秒下限は第3候補の全969実行で929→928件・総時間+0.51%となり撤回。既存の20%・最大30秒を維持。

F24.change: 30-digit strict guard screening with high-precision fallback near the boundary
F24.final_reason: 低精度guardの実験は直前のTRF版より速いが、余分な戦略を外した組合せを優先。最終版は元のguard評価を使用。

F25.change: Reuse Jacobian only while point is unchanged; rank chart before deficient full Newton
F25.final_reason: 同じ点のJacobianのみ再利用し、点が変われば破棄。rank-firstは2試行0成功で撤回し、元のNewton→rank-chart順序を維持。

F26.change: Static residual dependencies and disjoint-row finite difference coloring
F26.final_reason: 残差の静的依存が互いに交わらない列だけ差分を共有。不明な依存は全変数へ保守的に戻す。

F27.decision: Keep final verifier linear algebra unchanged
F27.reason: Exact-assembly profile: matrix correction 0.218s and inverse 0.048s; domain-margin numerical derivatives account for most verifier time. Insufficient benefit for verification-sensitive refactoring.
F27.final_reason: 最終検証の線形代数と閾値は維持。幾何述語だけ、完全な座標表現と計算精度が一致する場合の結果を最大512件再利用。可変Pointのidentityや丸めた値をkeyにしない。

F28.change: Skip repeated unscaled PSLQ and duplicate canonicalization
F28.final_reason: factor=1の重複PSLQと同一多項式の重複正規化を除去。探索上限と検証は変更しない。

F29.reason: Three profiles show 0.5-3 percent inclusive time; immutable evaluator snapshots already reuse work. Further shortcut is not justified.
F29.final_reason: snapshot互換性検査は維持。正確なmpf・int型の演算引数だけはfloat混入でないため、高精度モードのcontext参照を省略。floatとsubclassには既存検査を適用。

F30.decision: Keep exact degree, coefficient and verification limits unchanged
F30.reason: No profile-backed safe expansion identified; no benchmark-specific limit or expected-answer branching introduced.
F30.final_reason: No profile-backed safe expansion identified; no benchmark-specific limit or expected-answer branching introduced.

F31.decision: Keep worker serialization and save path unchanged
F31.reason: Profiled serialization under 0.4 percent; preserving partial publication and timeout behavior is more valuable than an unmeasured rewrite.
F31.final_reason: Profiled serialization under 0.4 percent; preserving partial publication and timeout behavior is more valuable than an unmeasured rewrite.

F32.reason: Angle cross product at 1e-200 scale underflows to zero in binary64 although 53-bit mpmath gives pi/2. Numeric probe records counterexample.
F32.final_reason: Angle cross product at 1e-200 scale underflows to zero in binary64 although 53-bit mpmath gives pi/2. Numeric probe records counterexample.

F33.reason: Isolated 2.2.1 backend speeds numerical microbenchmarks but fails 10 of 165 compatibility regressions, including mpz serialization. Main dependency lock and runtime remain Python backend.
F33.final_reason: Isolated 2.2.1 backend speeds numerical microbenchmarks but fails 10 of 165 compatibility regressions, including mpz serialization. Main dependency lock and runtime remain Python backend.

F34.change: Retain batch diagnostics and process-wall/p95/execution-layout measurements

verification_preservation.shared_rank_helper: Equilibration applies only when relative_tolerance is None; explicit verifier thresholds retain old path.
verification_preservation.additional_optimizations: Polygon predicate results are cached only for exact binary coordinates and active precision; their mathematical predicates are unchanged. Exact mpf/int operands bypass only the float-contamination context lookup.

candidate.status: adopted after full 969-run comparison and independent holdout
candidate.reason: Reject reserve-floor scheduling; reuse polygon predicates only for exact coordinates and precision, and omit context checks for exact mpf/int operand types. Adoption requires full comparison and independent holdout.
candidate.limitations: One development case/seed regressed; total accuracy and all-case time improved. Timing is a single campaign per source across three fixed seeds, not a statistical speed guarantee.
